# Game Idea: Cosmic Drift

Control a continuously‑moving spaceship in an HTML canvas starfield. Collect glowing particles for points while steering to avoid randomly generated asteroids. The ship accelerates forward automatically; the player uses mouse or touch to change direction.

**Lose condition:** The game ends if the ship collides with an asteroid or drifts off the visible canvas.

1: // Minimal Cosmic Drift game implementation
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
9:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   let ship = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, angle: 0, speed: 2, radius: 10 };
13:   const particles = [];
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   let score = 0;
16:   let gameOver = false;
17: 
18:   // Input handling – mouse & touch set ship direction
19:   // Audio setup (Web Audio API)
20:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
21:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
22:   // Ensure audio context resumes on first user interaction
23:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
24:   canvas.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, { once: true });
25:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', resumeAudio, { once: true });
26: 
27:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
28:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
29:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
30:     osc.type = 'sine';
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.connect(gain);
33:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
34:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
36:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
37:     osc.start();
38:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
39:   };
40: 
41:   const playCollect = () => playTone(600, 100);
42:   const playCrash = () => playTone(200, 300);
43: 
44:   const setDirection = (clientX, clientY) => {
45:   const setDirection = (clientX, clientY) => {
46:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
47:     const mx = clientX - rect.left;
48:     const my = clientY - rect.top;
49:     ship.angle = Math.atan2(my - ship.y, mx - ship.x);
50:   };
51:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => setDirection(e.clientX, e.clientY));
52:   canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
53:     e.preventDefault();
54:     const touch = e.touches[0];
55:     setDirection(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
56:   }, { passive: false });
57: 
58:   // Helper functions
59:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
60:   const spawnParticle = () => {
61:     particles.push({
62:       x: Math.random() * width,
63:       y: Math.random() * height,
64:       radius: 3,
65:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
66:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
67:     });
68:   };
69:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
70:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
71:     asteroids.push({
72:       x: Math.random() * width,
73:       y: Math.random() * height,
74:       radius: size,
75:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
76:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
77:     });
78:   };
79: 
80:   // Starfield background
81:   const stars = [];
82:   for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
83:     stars.push({
84:       x: Math.random() * width,
85:       y: Math.random() * height,
86:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
87:     });
88:   }
89: 
90:   // Initial spawns
91:   for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) spawnParticle();
92:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnAsteroid();
93: 
94:   const update = () => {
95:     if (gameOver) return;
96:     // Move ship forward
97:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
98:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
99: 
100:     // Boundary lose condition
101:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) {
102:       gameOver = true;
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Update particles (collect)
106:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:       const p = particles[i];
108:       p.x += p.vx;
109:       p.y += p.vy;
110:       // Wrap around edges for particles
111:       if (p.x < 0) p.x = width;
112:       if (p.x > width) p.x = 0;
113:       if (p.y < 0) p.y = height;
114:       if (p.y > height) p.y = 0;
115:       // Collection check
116:       if (dist(ship, p) < ship.radius + p.radius) {
117:         score++;
118:         particles.splice(i, 1);
119:         spawnParticle();
120:         playCollect();
121:       }
122:     }
123: 
124:     // Update asteroids
125:     for (const a of asteroids) {
126:       a.x += a.vx;
127:       a.y += a.vy;
128:       // Bounce off walls
129:       if (a.x < a.radius || a.x > width - a.radius) a.vx *= -1;
130:       if (a.y < a.radius || a.y > height - a.radius) a.vy *= -1;
131:       // Collision with ship
132:       if (dist(ship, a) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
133:         playCrash();
134:         gameOver = true;
135:       }
136:     }
137:   };
138: 
139:   const draw = () => {
140:     // Background gradient (deep space)
141:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
142:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
143:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
144:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
145:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
146: 
147:     // Starfield (twinkling)
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     for (const s of stars) {
150:       // slight flicker via random alpha each frame
151:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4;
152:       ctx.beginPath();
153:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
154:       ctx.fill();
155:     }
156:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0; // reset
157: 
158:     // Draw particles (glowing)
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
160:     for (const p of particles) {
161:       ctx.beginPath();
162:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
163:       ctx.fill();
164:     }
165: 
166:     // Draw asteroids with radial gradient shading
167:     for (const a of asteroids) {
168:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
169:         a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2,
170:         a.x, a.y, a.radius
171:       );
172:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
173:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
174:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
175:       ctx.beginPath();
176:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
177:       ctx.fill();
178:     }
179: 
180:     // Draw ship with thrust effect
181:     ctx.save();
182:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
183:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
184:     // Ship body
185:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
186:     ctx.beginPath();
187:     ctx.moveTo(ship.radius, 0);
188:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 2);
189:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 2);
190:     ctx.closePath();
191:     ctx.fill();
192:     // Thrust flame
193:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
194:     ctx.beginPath();
195:     ctx.moveTo(-ship.radius, 0);
196:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius - 6, -4);
197:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius - 6, 4);
198:     ctx.closePath();
199:     ctx.fill();
200:     ctx.restore();
201: 
202:     // UI overlay
203:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
204:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
205:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
206:     if (gameOver) {
207:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
208:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
209:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
210:     }
211:   };
212: 
213:   const loop = () => {
214:     update();
215:     draw();
216:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
217:   };
218: 
219:   // Start loop
220:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
221: })();

(End of file - total 221 lines)
</content>
